raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "pass through"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Poienile Izei"
      role time "per day"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "pass through"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Poienile Izei"
      role time "6 in the morning"
      polarity negated
    end
  end
